notes.title: Happy New Year from Digital Happiness, and More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/c14bc661ab130b4c379d3df241e46747e342d626.png[/img]

Greetings!

This year flew by in a whirlwind of hustles, and we all have grown through every milestone and challenge. Regardless the ups and downs, we want to wish you and your loved ones nothing but a new year with lots of joy, good health, and fortune.

Anyway, as we are about to wrap this year, we want to humbly ask you to help us improve DreadHaunt future updates, and tell us what game(s) we should make next!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/2fcf5cd09d47b83fc6ddeb9b8362d8e8660c88a4.png[/img]

Thank you so much for your endless support throughout the year. Once again, Happy New Year 2025!

Here's to many more,

Digital Happiness

notes.title: DreadHaunt 1.0 Is Here!
notes.content:
Hello Agents!

We're thrilled to announce that DreadHaunt 1.0 is finally here! After months of hard work, dedication, and countless sleepless nights, we're excited to bring you the full vision of a fun yet scary experience.

This update marks a significant milestone for our team. We've poured our hearts and souls into creating a truly haunting experience, and we can't wait to see what you think.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855580/DreadHaunt/

[h1]What's New in 1.0?[/h1]

[h2]New Gameplay Modes: Single Player Campaign[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/c1b8e7ad1ee4eaba9a41b02b44ffca8531011c62.gif[/img]
Experience the thrills of DreadHaunt, if you dare, in Single Player mode, And dive deeper into the DreadHaunt universe with an expanded lore.

[h2]Expanded Character Roster[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/bc528a019a18950415d750d291efbfca4c234bf8.gif[/img]
DreadHaunt 1.0 features a wider selection of playable characters, both Agents and the Spectromorphs will be unlocked as you play.

[h2][b](Free)[/b] Season Pass: Pilot[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/5b790f03cc736971d180b0176f0ada05afc3be72.jpg[/img]
In addition to new modes, agents, and Spectromorphs, you will also rewarded with more agent costumes, lore entries, titles, alternate NPC ghosts, and many more!

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
We couldn't have made it this far without your incredible support. Thank you for joining us on this terrifying journey. We can't wait to see what horrors await you in DreadHaunt 1.0.

Thank you for your support, and get haunting!

- Digital Happiness :DH

notes.title: Jurig Escape Is Available, For Free!
notes.content:
In 2010, before Digital Happiness is formed, we made Jurig Escape, a prototype that laid the foundation for our game development journey and would eventually evolve into to DreadOut, our darling title. So in celebration of DreadOut's 10th Anniversary, we made this very same prototype available on steam, completely free of charge, immortalizing it as a significant piece of our game development history.

Jurig Escape offers a brief yet intense survival horror experience that transports you back 14 years, when our passion for making games first ignited. 

Find out more on the store page, and in DreadOut 10th Anniversary sale page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2957940/Jurig_Escape/

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/DH/sale/dreadout10
